name: Yatou Akari
source:
She is the picturesque type of school girl you see anywhere today.  She is neither flamboyant nor gloomy. She is just an ordinary girl, with only top-middle grades in academics and athletics.

However, one day, she is suddenly summoned to another world, She is forced to become a Demon King. She was a member of the archery club, so she can handle a bow a little, but she has no other combat skills. Because of this, she is treated as a useless Demon King.

[From [url=http://www.ordin-soft.com/kusozako.html]official site[/url]]
